Applications now open! Welcome to Snackvivor, your friendly neighborhood yummalicious ORG! In Snackvivor, we focus on providing a high-quality ORG experience for all types of players, boasting an active, welcoming, and diverse community. Snackvivor: Pastadise Island is now casting 18 new players to cook up the best ORG you have ever seen! What we offer: ️ - An up and coming ORG community you can help build from the ground up (as a player or spectator!) - Interesting, entertaining, and thematically relevant twists to spice things up! - Fun challenges, spectator games, edgic, and more to keep everyone involved! - In server 1-on-1's and alliances for a great player and spectator experience - A wide array of incredible pasta emotes for added entertainment ️ - $50 Prize for the winner and many additional prizes for other players + spectators alike! So join Snackvivor today and cement your legacy in our fast-growing community! Applications close 2/22/2024 12:59 AM and castaways will be marooned into Snackvivor: Pastadise Island on 2/23/2024 7:00 PM!
Fruit Hando 2/2/2024 2:56 AM
cheese 2/3/2024 7:30 PM

Happy 1 Year of Snackvivor!

We truly cannot thank everyone here enough for all the amazing times we have had as a community. It is hard to believe how fast the time has gone by, but exactly one year ago to the minute, we set off for Cheeseland! Since then it has been nothing but incredible people coming together to laugh, love, cry, and all the other things we have done in Snackvivor. It has been so wonderful to see everyone rally behind the community and support each other, I can't wait for year two of Snackvivor because it is going to be even more of all the great things we have already done together. And on a personal note, I'm so grateful for all the people here in this community. When I stumbled into ORGs about a year and a half ago, I never thought they would have had as big of an impact on my life as they do. After playing my first ORG and experiencing the magic, I wanted to recreate that for so many more people. I'm so lucky for this hosting team, current and past, they are the best friends in the world and have brought me so much happiness and joy over the past year. I have so many great memories and I'm so thankful I get to call them my family. And to all our players and spectators, thank you for joining us on this journey and allowing us to be a great community. You are all the reason this place is so special and every day you continue to show how great the Snackvivor community is. So here is to many more years of Snackvivor! We have so much to celebrate (and a few surprises to do just that), so once again happy one year to Snackvivor!

Good morning snacks!! If you didn't know, Snackvivor is a partner in an org hub called Org Constellation (linked below) Every month, OrgC holds a vote for "Star Org of the Month", where people can vote for an org that finished a season during that month. Snackvivor is eligible for March's Star of the Month voting for Season 5! You can only vote if you were in the server before the form was posted, so if you were there - go vote for Snackvivor! (if you weren't - don't cheat, they'll check your username from the form) Even if you can't vote, you can join now and find other cool orgs to play and maybe vote for us in the future for other seasons! https://discord.com/invite/6UeQFMCV Link to the Voting Form (if you can vote): https://discord.com/channels/689597555872628874/689598359346085941/1224212880858153073

Applications now open! Welcome to Snackvivor, your friendly neighborhood yummalicious ORG! In Snackvivor, we focus on providing a high-quality ORG experience for all types of players, boasting an active, welcoming, and diverse community. Snackvivor: The Great Girl Scout Jamboree is now casting new players to bake up the best ORG you have ever seen! What we offer: - An experienced team of friendly and supportive production members ready to help make your Snackvivor experience one-of-a-kind! - Interesting, entertaining, and thematically relevant twists to spice things up! - Fun challenges, spectator games, edgic, and more to keep everyone involved! - In server 1-on-1's and alliances for a great player and spectator experience - A wide array of incredible cookie emotes for added entertainment - $50 Prize for the winner and many additional prizes for other players + spectators alike! So join Snackvivor today and cement your legacy in our fast-growing community! Applications close Tuesday, May 14, 2024 8:00 PM and castaways will be marooned into Snackvivor: The Great Girl Scout Jamboree on Thursday, May 16, 2024 7:00 PM!

Applications now open! Welcome to Snackvivor, your friendly neighborhood yummalicious ORG! In Snackvivor, we focus on providing a high-quality ORG experience for all types of players, boasting an active, welcoming, and diverse community. Snackvivor: Flapjack Falls is now casting 18 new players to bake up the best ORG you have ever seen! This will also be our last full newbie season before we have a returnee season - so now is the time to apply! What we offer: - An experienced team of friendly and supportive production members ready to help make your Snackvivor experience one-of-a-kind! - Interesting, entertaining, and thematically relevant twists to spice things up! - Fun challenges, spectator games, edgic, and more to keep everyone involved! - In server 1-on-1's and alliances for a great player and spectator experience - $50 Prize for the winner and many additional prizes for other players + spectators alike! So join Snackvivor today and cement your legacy in our fast-growing community!
